preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases, bounded by 1 ≤ T ≤ 10^5.
Each test case consists of exactly two space-separated integers X and Y.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isdigit() or c in '- ' for c in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1])
preconditions.description: X and Y are integers (possibly negative) with absolute values ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.
Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the minimum rounds of cleaning.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) <= 2 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The minimum rounds of cleaning is either 0, 1, or 2 for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((X == Y) or (X + a == Y and a % 2 == 1) or (X - b == Y and b % 2 == 0) or (X + a - b == Y and a % 2 == 1 and b % 2 == 0) for X, Y in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]] if (int(line) == 0 and X == Y) or (int(line) == 1 and ((X + a == Y and a % 2 == 1) or (X - b == Y and b % 2 == 0))) or (int(line) == 2 and (X + a - b == Y and a % 2 == 1 and b % 2 == 0)) for a in range(1, abs(Y - X) + 1, 2) for b in range(2, abs(Y - X) + 1, 2))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimum rounds of cleaning (0, 1, or 2) to reach Y from X using one positive odd integer a and one positive even integer b, where each round can either add a or subtract b.
